comments.任务：实现 computeAverage(studentList)，返回每人的三: Task: Implement computeAverage(studentList) to return each student's three identity fields and average grade as a string.
comments.思路：仅把四个成绩转换成 float 计算；计算结果再用 str 转回题目指定的: Approach: Convert only the four grades to float for calculation, then use str to convert the result back to the string type required by the exercise.
comments.易错点：题目例子为 '74.0' 而不是 '74.00'，因此不要强制统一两位小: Watch out: The example uses '74.0' rather than '74.00', so do not force every average to have two decimal places.
comments.完整保留原题五名学生和四次成绩；此多行赋值保存列表记录。: Keep all five students and their four grades from the exercise, using this assignment across several lines to store the list records.
comments.保留原题规定的函数名与参数名。: Keep the function and parameter names required by the exercise.
comments.创建返回列表，不修改传入的原始成绩记录。: Create the result list without changing the original input grade records.
comments.依照原学生顺序逐条处理记录。: Process one record at a time in the original student order.
comments.为当前学生重新初始化总分，避免混入前一个人的成绩。: Reset the total for the current student so that it does not include the previous student's grades.
comments.前三项是身份字段，从索引 3 到末尾才是四个成绩字符串。: The first three items are identity fields, and the four grade strings run from index 3 to the end.
comments.先将成绩变为数值，再累加到当前学生总分。: Convert the grade to a number before adding it to the current student's total.
comments.原题每人恰好四次测试，因此除以 4 得到算术平均分。: Each student has exactly four tests in the exercise, so divide by 4 to get the arithmetic mean.
comments.切片复制三个身份字段，另加字符串形式的平均分作为第四项。: Copy the three identity fields with a slice, then add the average as a string in the fourth position.
comments.将当前人的新记录追加到结果中。: Append the current student's new record to the result.
comments.全部学生处理完毕后返回新生成的嵌套列表。: Return the new nested list after all students have been processed.
comments.保存原题样例的函数返回值，便于按行展示全部五名学生。: Save the function's return value for the source example so that we can display all five students one record per line.
comments.逐条读取结果，显示顺序与原题一致。: Read the results one record at a time in the same order as the exercise.
comments.显示身份字段与平均分字符串，结果依次为 74.0、87.5、73.5、89.75: Display the identity fields and average strings, with averages of 74.0, 87.5, 73.5, 89.75, and 67.25 in order.
comments.任务：实现 highestAverage(studentList)，仅返回最高平: Task: Implement highestAverage(studentList) to return only the ID, first name, and last name of the student with the highest average.
comments.思路：复用第一问的结果，从第一名学生开始保存当前最优记录，再逐一比较。: Approach: Reuse the first part's result, start with the first student as the current best record, and compare the remaining students one by one.
comments.易错点：比较前将平均分字符串转换为 float；用严格大于保留并列第一人的约定。: Watch out: Convert average strings to float before comparison, and use strictly greater than to keep the first student when averages tie.
comments.保留原题规定的第二个函数名与参数名。: Keep the second function and parameter names required by the exercise.
comments.使用第一问函数生成每人的平均分，避免重复计算逻辑。: Use the first function to generate every student's average instead of duplicating the calculation logic.
comments.原题未规定空列表行为，这里明确返回空列表。: The exercise does not define empty-input behavior, so this solution explicitly returns an empty list.
comments.没有学生时无法选择最高者。: We cannot select a top student when there are no students.
comments.初始时把第一条记录作为当前最高者。: Start with the first record as the current best student.
comments.已选过第一人，只需遍历其后的学生。: The first student has already been selected, so check only the later students.
comments.用数值比较平均分；相等时不替换，保留最先出现的学生。: Compare averages as numbers, keeping the earlier student when the averages are equal.
comments.发现更高平均分时更新当前最高者。: Update the current best student when a higher average is found.
comments.返回前三项身份信息，不把平均分放进第二问的返回值。: Return the first three identity fields without including the average in the second part's return value.
comments.样例最高平均分为 Joe 的 89.75，输出与原题给出的身份列表一致。: Joe has the highest sample average of 89.75, and the output matches the identity list in the exercise.
comments.验证补充的空列表约定，预期显示 []。: Check the added empty-input policy, expecting [] to be displayed.
comments.任务：register_students() 读取姓名并返回 [(name, 0: Task: Have register_students() read names and return a list of records in the form [(name, 0), ...].
comments.思路：循环收集姓名；空行结束；每个新学生的缺勤次数都从 0 开始。: Approach: Collect names in a loop until a blank line is entered, starting each new student's absence count at 0.
comments.易错点：一名学生的两个字段放在一个元组中，所有学生元组放在同一个列表中。: Watch out: Put each student's two fields in one tuple and put all the student tuples in one list.
comments.导入标准库随机模块，供下一问真实随机选择使用。: Import the standard library random module for real random selection in the next part.
comments.定义原题要求的无参数注册函数。: Define the registration function with no parameters, as the exercise requires.
comments.建立外层可变列表，用于保存学生元组。: Create a mutable outer list to store the student tuples.
comments.反复询问姓名，直到读到空行。: Keep asking for names until a blank line is entered.
comments.去掉姓名首尾空格；只输入空格也视为结束。: Remove spaces at the start and end of the name, treating an answer containing only spaces as the end as well.
comments.空字符串是本材料明确选择的注册结束标记。: This material explicitly uses an empty string to end registration.
comments.将已经登记的全部学生记录交给调用者。: Return all the registered student records to the caller.
comments.先假定这个名字尚未登记。: Start by assuming that this name is not registered yet.
comments.逐条读取已有记录，检查完全相同的姓名。: Read the existing records one at a time to check for an exactly matching name.
comments.本材料采用区分大小写的精确姓名匹配。: This material matches names exactly and distinguishes uppercase from lowercase.
comments.找到同名记录后标记为已登记。: Mark the student as already enrolled when the same name is found.
comments.重复姓名不创建第二条记录，以避免查询歧义。: Do not create another record for a repeated name, so that later searches are unambiguous.
comments.告诉用户当前姓名已经登记过。: Tell the user that this name is already registered.
comments.只有不存在的姓名才加入列表。: Add the name to the list only if it is not already present.
comments.保存姓名与整数 0 构成的新元组。: Store a new tuple containing the name and the integer 0.
comments.任务：take_attendance(Stu_list, n) 随机抽查 n 名: Task: Have take_attendance(Stu_list, n) randomly check n different students and accumulate absences in the original list.
comments.思路：不重复抽取列表索引；把需要更新的元组换成同一位置的新元组。: Approach: Select list indices without repetition and replace each tuple that needs an update with a new tuple in the same position.
comments.易错点：元组不能写 record[1] += 1；需要修改 Stu_list[i: Watch out: We cannot use record[1] += 1 on a tuple, so we must update Stu_list[index] to save the change.
comments.定义原题指定的两个参数，Stu_list 是要直接更新的原列表。: Define the two parameters required by the exercise, with Stu_list holding the original list to update directly.
comments.抽查人数不能是负数，也不能多于已登记人数。: The number of students to check cannot be negative or exceed the number registered.
comments.对不合法人数给出可执行的提示，不进行抽样。: Give the user a helpful correction for an invalid count without taking a sample.
comments.提前结束本次抽查，原列表保持原样。: End this attendance round early and leave the original list unchanged.
comments.sample 在索引范围内不放回抽样，保证本次没有重复学生。: sample selects indices without replacement, ensuring that no student is chosen twice in this round.
comments.按本次抽中索引的顺序逐个询问出勤情况。: Ask for attendance in the order of the selected indices.
comments.把当前不可变元组拆成姓名与当前缺勤次数两个局部变量。: Unpack the current immutable tuple into two local variables: the name and the current absence count.
comments.提示中显示被抽中的姓名；统一大小写以接受 p 或 a。: Show the selected name in the prompt and normalize the response's case to accept p or a.
comments.原题假定 P 或 A；此循环只是避免误输入被悄悄当作出勤。: The exercise assumes P or A, and this loop simply prevents an invalid answer from silently counting as present.
comments.对同一名学生重新询问，直到得到合法回答。: Ask again about the same student until a valid answer is entered.
comments.只有 A 才代表本轮缺勤。: Only A means absent in this round.
comments.构造新元组并替换原列表对应位置，保存累计加一后的值。: Create a new tuple and replace the corresponding item in the original list, saving the count increased by one.
comments.任务：check_absences(student) 询问姓名并显示缺勤次数，未: Task: Have check_absences(student) ask for a name and display the absence count or the required message if the name is not registered.
comments.思路：student 接收整个学生列表；找到匹配姓名后显示次数并立即结束搜索。: Approach: student receives the whole student list, and a matching name causes the count to be displayed and the search to end immediately.
comments.易错点：Student not enrolled. 只能在全部记录都未匹配后显示: Watch out: Display Student not enrolled. only after every record fails to match, rather than after each individual nonmatching record inside the loop.
comments.保留原题签名；参数名 student 在这里指完整注册记录列表。: Keep the original function signature, with the parameter student meaning the full list of registered records here.
comments.读取要查询的姓名，采用与注册时一致的首尾空格处理。: Read the name to look up and remove leading and trailing spaces, just as registration does.
comments.逐个拆出已登记学生的姓名与缺勤数。: Unpack each registered student's name and absence count in turn.
comments.显示已累计的缺勤次数，文字格式与原题示例一致。: Display the accumulated absence count using the same text format as the source example.
comments.找到后立即结束，防止继续执行未登记提示。: Return immediately after a match so that the missing-name message is not displayed afterward.
comments.只有遍历结束仍未返回时，才说明该姓名没有登记。: Only reaching the end of the loop without returning means that the name is not registered.
comments.任务：main() 先注册，再反复显示菜单并调度抽查、查询或退出。: Task: Have main() register students first, then repeatedly display the menu and choose attendance, a lookup, or quitting.
comments.思路：学生列表只在进入菜单前创建一次，所有后续操作都共享这个列表。: Approach: Create the student list only once before entering the menu and share it across all later operations.
comments.易错点：不要在 while 菜单循环内部重新 register_students: Watch out: Do not call register_students again inside the while menu loop, because doing so would reset the absence counts.
comments.定义入口函数；定义本身不会立即读取输入。: Define the entry function; defining it does not immediately read any input.
comments.显示注册阶段的开头提示。: Display the opening message for registration.
comments.注册一次，并保存随后各轮菜单共同使用的列表。: Register once and save the list shared by every later menu round.
comments.直到用户选择退出，始终重复显示菜单。: Keep displaying the menu until the user chooses to quit.
comments.菜单选择保留为字符串，便于直接与字符选项比较。: Keep the menu choice as a string so that it can be compared directly with the option characters.
comments.捕获把非整数文本转换为 int 时可能出现的错误。: Catch the error that can occur when int tries to convert text that is not an integer.
comments.将抽查人数转换为整数，再交给考勤函数检查范围。: Convert the attendance count to an integer, then let the attendance function check its range.
comments.不是整数的输入无法用于抽样。: An answer that is not an integer cannot be used as the sample size.
comments.回到下一轮菜单，不使用尚未获得的 n。: Go back to the next menu round without using n, which has not been obtained yet.
comments.对同一个列表执行抽查，缺勤会保留到下一轮菜单。: Take attendance using the same list so that absences remain available in the next menu round.
comments.选项 2 查询当前已经累计的缺勤记录。: Option 2 looks up the absence counts accumulated so far.
comments.将整个注册列表传给原题名为 student 的参数。: Pass the full registered list to the parameter named student in the exercise.
comments.返回最终记录以便课堂核对；原题只要求退出，返回值是演示辅助。: Return the final records so that they can be checked in class; the exercise only requires quitting, and this return value supports the demonstration.
comments.其他选择不退出，也不修改学生数据。: Other choices neither quit nor change the student data.
comments.告诉用户合法的菜单数字。: Tell the user which menu numbers are valid.
comments.任务：自动复现原题的两轮抽查、三次查询和退出，验证 Bob 缺勤会累计到 2。: Task: Automatically replay the source example's two attendance rounds, three lookups, and quit to check that Bob's absences accumulate to 2.
comments.思路：只在演示块内替换输入和抽中索引；四个真实交互函数不包含这些预定答案。: Approach: Replace input and the selected indices only inside the demonstration block, keeping the four real interactive functions free of these prepared answers.
comments.易错点：随机抽样被替换仅为复现原题演示顺序，退出 with 后真实随机抽查立即恢: Watch out: Random selection is replaced only to replay the source example's order, and real random sampling returns immediately after the with block ends.

comments.第二轮抽查 2 人；Charlie 出勤、Bob 再次缺勤。: Check 2 students in the second round, with Charlie present and Bob absent again.

comments.查询未登记的 David，随后选择退出。: Look up David, who is not registered, then choose to quit.
comments.定义用于显示提示与模拟回答的演示输入函数。: Define the demonstration input function that displays prompts and simulated answers.
comments.从预定回答序列读取下一条字符串。: Read the next string from the prepared answer sequence.
comments.保留完整的交互记录，显示本次问题和对应回答。: Keep a complete interaction record by displaying the current prompt and its answer.
comments.返回字符串，与真正 input 的行为保持一致。: Return a string, matching the behavior of real input.
comments.第一轮索引为 Bob、Alice，第二轮为 Charlie、Bob；每轮的索引互: Select Bob and Alice by index in the first round and Charlie and Bob in the second, with no repeated index within either round.
comments.仅为本次演示临时替换输入函数。: Temporarily replace the input function only for this demonstration.

comments.执行主程序并保存退出时最终列表，整个过程不会等待键盘输入。: Run the main program and save the final list on quitting, without waiting for keyboard input at any point.
comments.显示最终记录，Bob 的缺勤为 2，另两人仍为 0。: Display the final records, with Bob at 2 absences and the other two students still at 0.
